rows: Ensure that the unit to be worked on is shut down
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories
Provide a safety fence with caution marks around the work area of the equipment
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as the safety helmet, gloves, masks and safety shoes
Set of open-end wrenches and box wrenches, sizes 10 to 36 mm
Vernier caliper, depth gauge and ratchet

A special fixture consisting of a
Disk
with a stud with two nuts ending in a coupling groove similar to the original valve stem

WD40 rust-removing spray
and fine sandpaper

Remove the flange of the oil inlet and outlet line pipes from the valve, and drain
the oil

Measure the length of
the adjusting screw Regulating
bolt
to determine the spring force
Remove the adjusting screw
Remove the bolts of the upper half of the upper valve and lift it off

Pull out the small-diameter spring together with the
Spring cab
The Small piston is removed

Remove the large spring and disconnect the coupling between the valve stem and the large
cylinder stem
The large cylinder is removed

Install the fixtures mentioned in step (3) and tighten the stud until
it reaches the lower stem of the valve

Loosen the nut and tap the stud lightly, so that the stem drops down
inside the valve
Repeat the previous two steps, spraying rust remover, until the valve can be removed easily
Clean the dismantled parts and replace the damaged ones
Start reassembling the valve by disconnecting the coupling and lifting the fixture
Lower the large cylinder and install the coupling

Lower the large spring, then lower
the small cylinder, then the small spring with its cover
Spring Cab

Apply heat-resistant Molykote to the flange of the valve fixed body, then fit the cover
and tighten the valve bolts

Measure the length of the adjusting screw
Regulating Bolt
and check it against the previously recorded values
Refit the flange of the oil line pipe (inlet - return)
Start the oil pump and check the oil lines for leakage

Safety Precautions
Ensure that the unit to be worked on is shut down | 
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories | 
Provide a safety fence with caution marks around the work area of the equipment | 
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as the safety helmet, gloves, masks and safety shoes | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Set of open-end wrenches and box wrenches, sizes 10 to 36 mm | 
Vernier caliper, depth gauge and ratchet | 
A special fixture consisting of a
Disk
with a stud with two nuts ending in a coupling groove similar to the original valve stem | 
WD40 rust-removing spray
and fine sandpaper | 
Work to be Carried Out
Remove the flange of the oil inlet and outlet line pipes from the valve, and drain
the oil | 1.
Measure the length of
the adjusting screw Regulating
bolt
to determine the spring force | 2.
Remove the adjusting screw | 3.
Remove the bolts of the upper half of the upper valve and lift it off | 4.
Pull out the small-diameter spring together with the
Spring cab | 5.
The Small piston is removed | 6.
Remove the large spring and disconnect the coupling between the valve stem and the large
cylinder stem | 7.
The large cylinder is removed | 8.
Install the fixtures mentioned in step (3) and tighten the stud until
it reaches the lower stem of the valve | 9.
Loosen the nut and tap the stud lightly, so that the stem drops down
inside the valve | 10
Repeat the previous two steps, spraying rust remover, until the valve can be removed easily | 11.
Clean the dismantled parts and replace the damaged ones | 12.
Start reassembling the valve by disconnecting the coupling and lifting the fixture | 13.
Lower the large cylinder and install the coupling | 14.
Lower the large spring, then lower
the small cylinder, then the small spring with its cover
Spring Cab | 15.
Apply heat-resistant Molykote to the flange of the valve fixed body, then fit the cover
and tighten the valve bolts | 16.
Measure the length of the adjusting screw
Regulating Bolt
and check it against the previously recorded values | 17.
Refit the flange of the oil line pipe (inlet - return) | 18.
Start the oil pump and check the oil lines for leakage | 19.

uncertain_terms.note: Unclear tool name; possibly a transliteration of 'ratchet'. Rendered 'ratchet'. MPIS EN uses 'ratchet' (ratchet wheel).
Literally 'purpose'; in a checklist table it reads as the item column. Rendered 'Item'.

uncertain_terms.context: Test sheet row (arabic-web filing); gen-docs filing already has 'Starting Current'
اسحب السوستة ذات القطر الصغير ومعه Spring cab / السوستة الصغيرة وعليها الغطاء الخاصة بها Spring Cab
uncertain_terms.note: Kept verbatim as in the source; 'cab' is almost certainly a typo for 'cap' (the spring cover, الغطاء الخاصة بها).

uncertain_terms.context: ادهن فلانشة الجسم الثابت للبلف بالميلكوت الحرارى
uncertain_terms.note: Transliteration of the brand 'Molykote' (heat-resistant). Rendered 'heat-resistant Molykote'. MPIS EN uses 'Molykote'.

uncertain_terms.context: يتم قياس طول مسمار الضبط Regulating الترباس لتحديد قوة السوستة
uncertain_terms.note: Source mixes 'adjusting screw' (مسمار الضبط) with the English 'Regulating Bolt' (الترباس = bolt). Kept both as in the source.

uncertain_terms.context: فك الصامولة والطرق الخفيف على الفتيل مما يؤدى الى نزول العامود بقلب البلف
uncertain_terms.note: Literally 'in the heart of the valve'; rendered 'inside the valve' (stem drops down into the valve).

uncertain_terms.context: مجموعة مفاتيح بلدى ومفاتيح حلقية من مقاس 10 الى 36مم
uncertain_terms.note: Rendered as box wrenches; MPIS EN uses 'box wrenches' (open-end box wrenches).

uncertain_terms.context: يتم تركيب التجهيزات المذكورة فى الخطوة رقم (3)
uncertain_terms.note: Step reference kept verbatim as in the source; the fixture is described in the tools list, not in step 3.

uncertain_terms.context: المعدة: بلوف التحكم الرئيسية للتربينة gmd abb
uncertain_terms.note: Kept verbatim in lower case as in the source; 'gmd' is presumably a valve model/type code and 'abb' the manufacturer ABB.

uncertain_terms.context: صادرة الى: أسيوط البخارية 3 30x م و
uncertain_terms.note: Rendered as '3 x 30 MW' (three 30 MW units); 'م و' = MW.
